"""Execute the current W.4 guide examples and persist exact-source evidence."""
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/workspace/tiny-perceptron-vlm')
now=lambda:datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
started=now()
source='course/first-steps.md'
raw=(root/source).read_bytes()
headings=list(re.finditer(rb'(?m)^## ([A-Z\d]+\.\d+) [^\r\n]+',raw))
parts={h[1].decode():raw[h.start():headings[i+1].start() if i+1<len(headings) else len(raw)] for i,h in enumerate(headings)}
section=parts['W.4']
fences=re.findall(r'```python\n(.*?)\n```',section.decode(),re.S)
assert len(fences)==1
code=fences[0]
assert 'round(1.0625, 3)' in section.decode()
assert code.count('[0.9, 0.5, 0.1]')==1
examples=[('original',code),('exercise_add_0_25',code.replace('[0.9, 0.5, 0.1]','[0.9, 0.5, 0.1, 0.25]')),('inline_midpoint','print(round(1.0625, 3))\nassert round(1.0625, 3) == 1.062\n')]
env={**os.environ,'OMP_NUM_THREADS':'1','MKL_NUM_THREADS':'1'}
records=[]
for name,program in examples:
 command=[str(root/'.venv/bin/python'),'-c',program]
 r=subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
 rows=r.stdout.strip().splitlines()
 if name=='original': assert rows==['0.9 0.105 0.152','0.5 0.693 1.0','0.1 2.303 3.322'],rows
 if name=='exercise_add_0_25': assert rows==['0.9 0.105 0.152','0.5 0.693 1.0','0.1 2.303 3.322','0.25 1.386 2.0'],rows
 if name=='inline_midpoint': assert rows==['1.062'],rows
 records.append({'case':name,'program':program,'program_sha256':sha(program.encode()),'command':command,'exit_code':r.returncode,'stdout':r.stdout,'stderr':r.stderr})
version=subprocess.check_output([str(root/'.venv/bin/python'),'-c','import json,platform;print(json.dumps({"python":platform.python_version(),"platform":platform.platform()}))'],cwd=root,text=True)
assert (root/source).read_bytes()==raw,'Source changed during guide execution'
receipt={'schema_version':1,'started_at':started,'checked_at':now(),'status':'passed','lesson_id':'W.4','source':source+'#W.4','source_sha256':sha(section),'scope':'Actual short local CPU execution of the current guide Python fence, its specified add-0.25 exercise, and the new inline midpoint example. This guide has no generated notebook; this is not a kernel, remote Colab, GPU, or full-book offline execution receipt.','command':'.venv/bin/python /tmp/verify-corrected-guide.py','environment':{**json.loads(version),'omp_num_threads':'1','mkl_num_threads':'1'},'result':{'total':len(records),'passed':len(records),'failed':0},'records':records,'verification_program':Path(__file__).read_text()}
p=root/'docs/validation-artifacts/technical-revision-W.4-guide-code.json'
p.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'receipt':str(p.relative_to(root)),'passed':True,'source_sha256':receipt['source_sha256'],'cases':len(records)}))
